t: A staff corps officer of the grade of ensign shall be eligible for promotion to the grade of lieutenant (junior grade) on the third anniversary of the date of rank stated in his commission as ensign.

fable.w: This provision only sets a time-in-grade eligibility rule for promoting Navy staff corps ensigns, who are federal personnel. There is no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, or right to sue involving any party outside the federal government, so there is not even a tempting participation reading here.
fable.s: A staff corps officer of the grade of ensign shall be eligible for promotion to the grade of lieutenant (junior grade) on the third anniversary of the date of rank stated in his commission as ensign.
